# 3 bed semi-detached house for sale

> Dooley Poynton Auctioneers are delighted to present for sale two exclusive, architecturally designed homes in the heart of the charming village of Redcross, Co. Wicklow. Finished to an exceptional standard and achieving an impressive A rated BER, these outstanding homes combine contemporary comfort, energy efficiency and timeless appeal.

- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 3 bed
- Plocha: 118 m²
- Energetická náročnost: A1
- Lokalita: Main Street Redcross, Wicklow Town
